record.title: Evaluate raw acquisition readiness and choose the survey boundary
record.intent: Admit a bounded frequency survey only when the raw acquisition and estimator evidence support it.
requirements: Evaluate raw sample semantics, voltage scaling, complete record extent, actual sample rate, restoration and recorder health. Distinguish raw acquisition from the prior display record.
Assess source-shape and aliasing limits, choose a frozen modest frequency grid and reference repeats, and retain negative outcomes without extending the same experiment.

If supported, draft, plan-inspect, admit and commit a separate current-policy survey before execution. Otherwise record the smallest bounded remedy or exact bench question; do not release the matched-policy comparison gate.
acceptance: A supported survey continuation or precise remaining acquisition question is recorded.
